xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4329: Session Vault: carry uncommitted work with a conversation (encrypted WIP snapshots)

plan.title: Session Vault: carry uncommitted work with a conversation (encrypted WIP snapshots)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Resuming a Session Vault conversation on another machine moves the transcript but not the uncommitted code; with the origin machine off, those edits cannot be fetched later and the drift prompt can only warn.
narratives.Proposal: On the owner machine, build a WIP commit from a temporary index seeded with a copy of the user index, bundle it with every unpushed commit (--not --remotes), secret-scan every carried commit, cap the size, and store it as zstd+AES-GCM parts through VaultStore referenced from the settlement `wip` field (auto mode throttled to 5 minutes, force mode on the Stop hook and pan vault save, last 5 kept). On resume, require a clean checkout (or a fresh --worktree), fetch origin, unbundle into refs/overdeck/wip/<vaultId>, check out branch at base without moving any branch backward, apply the base..wip diff unstaged, delete the temp ref, then adopt and launch. --no-code skips it. Full design and decisions D-1..D-17 in .pan/drafts/pan-4329.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Preserving staged-vs-unstaged state; everything is applied unstaged in v1
- Carrying submodule working trees, LFS objects or clean/smudge-filtered content beyond their git-clean form; autocrlf normalization
- Pushing WIP refs or snapshots to the project origin or any git host
- Garbage-collecting unreferenced snapshot objects in the vault backend
- Dashboard shutdown trigger, managed session-end trigger and dashboard "Continue here" apply (PAN-4307 calls the lib API)
- Adding a Claude Code SessionEnd hook
- Native Windows verification
- A vault format version bump
- Any use of execSync, git stash, or writes to the user index/worktree during capture

autoDecisions.summary: Capture modes: auto (5-minute throttle, then (base,tree) compare) for auto-settle and pan vault sync; force (always compare, retry secret/error skips) for the Stop hook, pan vault save, session end and shutdown.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says "at most every 5 minutes" for settlement-triggered capture and "always" for explicit triggers; comparing the (base,tree) pair avoids duplicate snapshots, and retrying secret/error skips lets allow-secret take effect.

autoDecisions.summary: On a noop settlement in force mode the latest settlement wip is replaced in place; no settlement is appended.
autoDecisions.rationale: Appending a settlement without new lines would create phantom versions for pan vault show and versionAtLineCount.

autoDecisions.summary: The secret scan covers every commit the bundle carries (git log -p <wip> --not --remotes), not only git diff HEAD <wip>.
autoDecisions.rationale: Unpushed local commits travel in the bundle too; scanning only HEAD..wip would upload their secrets unchecked.

autoDecisions.summary: Code allow flow extends `pan vault allow-secret` with --file <path> storing line hashes under the same vaultId key.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the same allow flow as FR-13; transcript line numbers cannot address code, so file + content hash is the smallest extension.

autoDecisions.summary: Bundle parts are 8 MiB, with a domain-separated HMAC id; the 50 MB cap is measured on the bundle file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The git backend writes each object as a file and pushes it, so parts stay far below the 50 MB GitHub warning; the pack inside the bundle is already compressed.

autoDecisions.summary: Standalone dirty target: TTY prompt for a sibling worktree, non-TTY exits 1 naming --worktree; Overdeck-mode workspace creation belongs to PAN-4307.
autoDecisions.rationale: The standalone CLI must not import Overdeck workspace code (import-graph test), and a non-interactive run must never write.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply never moves a branch backward: detach at base when the local branch diverged or is checked out in another worktree.
autoDecisions.rationale: The AC requires HEAD equal to A HEAD; detaching satisfies it without discarding local commits.

autoDecisions.summary: No SessionEnd hook; the per-turn Stop hook is the standalone session-end trigger, and dashboard shutdown/session end are PAN-4307 call sites.
autoDecisions.rationale: Stop fires after the final turn; the dashboard does not settle yet, so its triggers belong with PAN-4307.

metadata.sizeJustification: One vertical feature (capture on machine A, apply on machine B) whose headline AC is a two-machine round trip; 24 files. The subsystem count exceeds 6 only because the two-segment rule counts each single doc file (docs/SESSION-VAULT.md, configuration/session-vault.mdx, sync-sources/skills) and the generated manifest (packages/contracts) as separate subsystems. Splitting capture from apply would ship a sibling that stores snapshots nothing can read.

items.title: Add encrypted WIP part encoding, skip fields and wipMaxBytes config

verify_commands: npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/vault/wip-format.test.ts tests/unit/lib/vault/format.test.ts tests/unit/lib/vault/config.test.ts

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4329.md WI-1. In src/lib/vault/format.ts add WIP_PART_BYTES (8 MiB), wipPartIdFor (HMAC over "overdeck-wip-part-v1\0"+bytes, domain-separated from chunk ids), encodeWipParts (split, zstd, AES-256-GCM with aad=id) and decodeWipParts (decrypt, decompress, id-check, concatenate; any failure throws VaultAuthenticationError). Extend the skipped variant of WipSnapshotRef with optional base and tree and update the reserved-field comments. In src/lib/vault/config.ts add wipMaxBytes (default 52428800) to VaultConfig, defaults and withDefaults.

items.title: Given a 20 MiB random buffer, when encodeWipParts then decodeWipParts run, then 3 parts are produced and the decoded bytes equal the input
Given identical bytes, wipPartIdFor returns a different id than chunkIdFor, so a part id never collides with a transcript chunk id
Given one flipped byte in a stored part or two parts swapped in order, decodeWipParts rejects with VaultAuthenticationError
Given no vault config file, readVaultConfig() returns wipMaxBytes equal to 52428800
Add scanWipPatch secret scan for code patches

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add WipSecretHit {file, pattern, hash} and scanWipPatch(vaultId, patch) to src/lib/vault/secrets.ts: track the file from "+++ b/<path>" headers (fall back to "--- a/<path>" when +++ is /dev/null), scan only lines starting with "+" and not "+++" with findSecretMatches, hash = lineHash(line.slice(1)), skip hashes in allowedSecretHashes(vaultId), one hit per (file, line, pattern), never include the matched text.

items.title: Given a patch that adds a ghp_ token in src/a.ts, scanWipPatch returns one hit with file "src/a.ts" and pattern "token"
Given the same token only on a removed (-) or context line, scanWipPatch returns no hits
Given allowSecret(vaultId, hit.hash) was stored, a rescan returns an empty array
JSON.stringify of the scan result never contains the token text
Create wip-capture.ts: temp-index WIP commit, bundle, secret scan, size cap, encrypted upload

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and decisions D-1, D-9, D-10. New module src/lib/vault/wip-capture.ts exporting WipMode, WIP_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC=300, WIP_KEEP=5, WipCaptureResult, runWipGit (promisified execFile with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and fixed Overdeck Session Vault author/committer env), latestWipEntry, pruneWipEntries, buildWipCommit (temp index seeded from a COPY of `git rev-parse --git-path index`, add -A, write-tree, commit-tree -p HEAD; null for non-repo or unborn HEAD), wipPatch (git log -p --no-color <wip> --not --remotes) and captureWip (throttle on wip.at before git; unchanged by (base,tree) pair per D-1; skipped clean when tree equals HEAD tree and nothing is unpushed; no-git returned but never persisted; update-ref refs/overdeck/wip/<vaultId>-<pid>; bundle create <tmpfile> <ref> --not --remotes; update-ref -d in finally; size cap; scanWipPatch; encodeWipParts + putObjects). Never execSync, never git stash, no shell pipes; temp files under mkdtemp removed in finally. Imports only node built-ins, sibling vault modules and ../secret-redaction.js.

items.title: Given a fixture repo with an unpushed commit, staged, unstaged, untracked, deleted, binary and force-added ignored files, captureWip returns captured with base equal to HEAD and at least one object written to the dir store

captureWip preserves the sha256 of the user index file, `git stash list` (empty), `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` and `git for-each-ref refs/overdeck/` (empty) exactly as they were before capture
Given a ghp_ token in an untracked file, captureWip returns skipped "secret" with hits naming that file and pattern, and no file is added under the store objects directory
Given maxBytes 10, captureWip returns skipped "too-large" with bytes > 10 and writes no object; a clean pushed checkout returns skipped "clean"; a non-repo cwd returns status "no-git" with no wip

given a captured snapshot, a byte scan of every backend file returns no match for "# v2 git bundle", "refs/overdeck/wip/", the WIP commit sha, or a random marker string written into the untracked file
Attach WIP capture to settle() with auto/force/off modes, noop amend and retention

expected_outputs: settle-wip.test.ts and existing settle tests pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 and decisions D-1, D-2, D-3, D-8. SettleOptions gains wip?: WipMode (default auto); SettleResult noop/append gain wip?: WipCaptureResult. Append path: before casRef call captureWip for the target record (owned record or the P-6 fork) with previous=latestWipEntry(record.settlements), maxBytes=config.wipMaxBytes; set settlement.wip for captured/skipped; prune to 5 captured entries on capture. Noop path: only in force mode and when this machine owns the record, capture and replace the LAST settlement wip in place, prune, casRef with the read version; a conflict returns plain noop. Tests inject now; no real timers.

items.title: given a first settle in a dirty repo, settle returns result.wip.status "captured" and persists the captured wip on the last settlement; a non-git cwd produces a settlement with no wip field
given a second settle 60 s later in default auto mode, settle returns result.wip.status "throttled" and the new settlement has no wip field; with wip "force" it returns "captured"
given a noop settle with wip "force" after an edit, settle preserves the settlement count and updates the last settlement wip.tree and wip.at in place
given 7 forced captures with distinct edits, the stored record contains exactly 5 settlements with a captured wip
given a record now owned by another environment, settle stores the wip on the P-6 fork record and preserves the original record ref bytes unchanged
pan vault save captures in force mode and prints the code snapshot outcome

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. saveHook and saveCommand pass wip: "force" to settle. describeVerdict appends the WIP outcome (saved size, unchanged, blocked file (pattern) with the `pan vault allow-secret <id8> --file <file>` hint, too-large with cap, failed reason; nothing for no-git). saveCommand exits 1 on a secret or error skip; hook mode stays silent and exits 0.

items.title: Given a secret in the working tree, `pan vault save <path>` output names the file and pattern "token", does not contain the token value, suggests allow-secret --file, and exits 1
Given the same secret in hook mode, nothing is written to stdout or stderr and the command returns normally
Given a clean change, `pan vault save` prints "code snapshot saved" and exits 0
Add `pan vault allow-secret <id> --file <path>` for blocked code lines

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 and D-5. Register `allow-secret <id-or-path> [line]` with `--file <path>`; exactly one of line or --file is required. For --file: resolve the owned vaultId, loadRecord, buildWipCommit(record.cwd), scanWipPatch over wipPatch, allowSecret(vaultId, hash) for each hit in that file, cleanup, print the count and the retry hint; zero hits exits 1. Regenerate packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts (npm run build, then node scripts/generate-slash-commands.mjs) and commit it in this item.

items.title: Given a blocked code snapshot, `allow-secret <id> --file <path>` followed by `pan vault save` produces a captured snapshot
Given neither a line number nor --file, the command exits 1 with "Give a line number or --file <path>."
Given a file with no blocked lines, the command exits 1 with "No blocked lines in <file>."
bash scripts/lint-slash-commands.sh exits 0 with the regenerated manifest containing the --file option
Create wip-apply.ts: verify, unbundle, checkout base, apply unstaged, worktree variant

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7 and decisions D-12, D-13, D-14. New module src/lib/vault/wip-apply.ts exporting findLatestWip, WipApplyResult, applyWipSnapshot and applyWipSnapshotInWorktree. Dirty check first (readCwdState) and return {status:"dirty"} before any other git call. Then fetch parts, decodeWipParts, write the bundle to a temp file, fetch origin (non-fatal) BEFORE bundle verify (verify needs the prerequisite commits), bundle verify, bundle list-heads (exactly one), fetch <head>:refs/overdeck/wip/<vaultId>, check tree and parent against the record, checkout per D-12 (never move a branch backward), git diff --binary base..ref to a temp patch, git apply, delete the temp ref and temp dir in finally. Worktree variant fetches in the repo, `git worktree add --detach <dir> <base>`, applies there.

items.title: given a snapshot captured in clone A, applyWipSnapshot in a fresh clean clone B produces byte- and mode-identical tracked and untracked files (ignored files absent), B HEAD equal to A HEAD, nothing staged, and an empty refs/overdeck/
Given a dirty clone B, applyWipSnapshot returns "dirty" and B status --porcelain and index hash are unchanged
given a local branch that diverged from base, applyWipSnapshot returns applied with a note, HEAD detached at base, and preserves the branch tip
Given a tampered part, applyWipSnapshot returns "failed" and B is unchanged; given a clone B made before A last push, apply still succeeds because origin is fetched before bundle verify
Given a dirty repo, applyWipSnapshotInWorktree produces the identical tree in the new directory and leaves the dirty repo status and index hash unchanged
pan vault resume applies the latest code snapshot with --no-code and --worktree

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8 and decisions D-11, D-14, D-15, D-16. Add --no-code and --worktree <dir> to resume. After resolveTargetCwd: latest captured wip (unless --no-code) is applied before adoption; dirty target prompts on a TTY for a sibling worktree `<cwd>-vault-<id8>`, non-TTY exits 1 naming --worktree; applied snapshot skips the FR-12 drift prompt; skipped entry prints "No code snapshot: skipped (...)" and runs FR-12; failed exits 1 with nothing adopted; adopt conflict after apply prints the D-15 message and exits 1. Update the existing tests/unit/cli/vault/resume.test.ts drift tests (ac2, ac3 and any other test expecting the FR-12 prompt) to pass code: false, because their no-remote fixture repo now always carries a snapshot.
